title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**UI/UX Designer**

Remote · Full-time · Competitive salary + stock option

At VELZI AI, we’re building the future of financial automation. Our AI-powered platform eliminates manual accounting tasks and brings intelligent, seamless workflows to businesses of all sizes. We’re creating more than just software, we’re reimagining how finance works.

We’re now looking for a highly creative UI/UX Designer who not only imagines beautiful, intuitive interfaces but can also bring them to life in Figma, Framer, and code. If you’re passionate about crafting exceptional user experiences and want to make a tangible impact in a fast-moving startup, we’d love to meet you.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Do:**

**Design with Impact** – Create elegant, modern, and user-centric designs in Figma, with a deep focus on usability, aesthetics, and consistency.  
**Prototype in Framer** – Build interactive, high-fidelity prototypes in Framer to bring ideas to life and test user flows.  
**Convert Designs to Code** – Translate your own Figma designs into clean, responsive HTML/CSS to support rapid development and prototyping.  
**Define UI Systems** – Develop scalable design systems and UI libraries for use across our product ecosystem.  
**Collaborate Closely** – Work hand-in-hand with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to align design with business goals and technical feasibility.  
**User Testing & Feedback** – Help conduct usability testing, collect user feedback, and iterate quickly to improve experiences.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What We’re Looking For:**  
**Figma Mastery** – You have strong expertise designing end-to-end user interfaces and components in Figma.  
**Framer Proficiency** – You can build compelling interactive prototypes and product experiences directly in Framer.  
**HTML/CSS Skills** – You’re able to bring your designs to life in the browser with responsive, semantic, maintainable code.  
**Design Systems Mindset** – You can think in systems, ensuring consistency across components, states, and platforms.  
**Mobile & Desktop Awareness** – You know how to craft interfaces that feel right on any screen size.  
**Pixel-Perfect Mentality** – You obsess over spacing, alignment, typography, and visual hierarchy.  
**Fast & Iterative Approach** – You love refining ideas quickly and working in sprints. **Bonus:** JavaScript familiarity, motion design, or experience with tools like Lottie or GSAP.

**Benefits**
------------

**Why Join VELZI AI?**

Shape the Future – Design the next generation of AI-driven fintech tools.  
Startup Energy – Small team, big ambition, and your ideas matter every day.  
Learn & Grow – Work with cutting-edge tools and forward-thinking engineers and designers.  
Remote Freedom – Work from anywhere with a results-first, flexible schedule.  
Career Growth – As VELZI AI scales, you’ll grow with us.  
Compensation & Equity – Competitive salary + meaningful stock options for every team members.

**How to Apply:**

Click "Apply" now or go to https://velzi. ai/career. We want to see real examples of your design work, Figma files, live Framer prototypes, or HTML/CSS builds!

Join VELZI AI and redefine fintech, one beautifully crafted interface at a time.

title: UI/UX Designer - Web/Digital Marketing
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Job Summary**

*Role Purpose*

Candescent is seeking a thoughtful, detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our website and digital experiences from one of our India office locations. You will design intuitive, on-brand experiences from wireframe through high-fidelity mockup, working closely with web, marketing, and product marketing teams to bring ideas to life.

This is a hands-on design role for someone who enjoys solving user problems through clean, purposeful design and who wants to see their work built and shipped quickly. You will work closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

**Design & Delivery**

* Design wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity UI for web pages, landing pages, and digital experiences in Figma.
* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows and information architecture.
* Design and iterate on landing pages and campaign assets in support of marketing and demand generation initiatives.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by designing test variants for key pages and conversion flows.

**Design Systems & Consistency**

* Create and maintain a design system and component library to ensure visual consistency across the site.
* Apply Candescent brand standards consistently across all digital work, including typography, colour, iconography, and imagery.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices (WCAG) and are optimised for performance.

**Research & Validation**

* Conduct or contribute to user research and usability testing, and gather feedback to inform design decisions.
* Use analytics and test results to identify usability problems and prioritise improvements.
* Stay current on design trends, tools, and best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the team.

**Collaboration & Ways of Working**

* Collaborate closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively, and support a clean handoff.
* Partner with stakeholders across marketing, product marketing, and sales to gather requirements and present design concepts.
* Present and explain design decisions clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably for web or digital marketing.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and prototyping.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, typography, and layout skills.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and designing for multiple breakpoints and devices.
* Working knowledge of UX best practices, user flows, and information architecture.
* Ability to translate business and marketing goals into clear, user-centred design solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented, with a strong sense of visual polish and consistency.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**

*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Hands-on experience building or editing sites in Webflow is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how designs translate to code is preferred.
* Experience with user research or usability testing methods is a plus.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation principles is a plus.
* Experience designing for SEO-friendly page structures is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Designs are intuitive, on-brand, and elevate the overall user experience.
* Design-to-development handoff is smooth, with minimal rework needed.
* A well-maintained, scalable design system that speeds up future work.
* Measurable improvements in usability and conversion on redesigned pages.
* Stakeholders receive clear rationale for design decisions, not just deliverables.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* Genuine curiosity about how users behave, and willingness to let evidence change the design.
* Comfort designing within an established brand system rather than starting from a blank page.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

**Portfolio Submission**

*Required with every application*

A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed. Please include a link to an online portfolio or an attached PDF, with access credentials if the work is password protected, along with three to five selected pieces that best demonstrate your web and digital design work. For each piece, include a short note describing the brief, your specific contribution, and the outcome.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

description:

title: Senior Designer
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

### **About the Role**

Monks is seeking an experienced Senior Designer to join a regional creative team producing rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. Working in close partnership with client stakeholders and a distributed global team, this role will apply established brand systems to polished digital and web-based deliverables while maintaining a consistently high standard of craft.

The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Figma, comfortable working within robust design systems and able to translate complex information into clear, engaging visual communication. You will be expected to work autonomously, move confidently within established guidelines and thoroughly review your own work before it advances.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.

### **In This Role, You Will**

* Design high-quality editorial, marketing and web-based assets using established brand guidelines, templates and component systems.
* Translate complex technical and product information into clear visual hierarchies, diagrams, charts and supporting graphics.
* Apply strong UX and web design principles across responsive digital layouts.
* Work fluently in Figma, including shared libraries, components, auto layout, variables and approved plugins.
* Adapt existing design systems thoughtfully while maintaining brand consistency across deliverables.
* Partner with the Design Director, technical writers, motion designers and producers to bring briefs to life.
* Interpret briefs and feedback independently, identifying gaps and asking focused questions when clarification is required.
* Prepare organized, production-ready files that can be easily understood and continued by distributed teams.
* Support clear, documented handoffs when work continues across regions or shifts.
* Conduct thorough self-QA for content accuracy, alignment, spacing, typography, responsiveness, accessibility, specifications and version control.
* Incorporate feedback quickly while preserving the integrity of the design system and approved direction.
* Use approved AI and creative technology tools to support exploration, efficiency and consistency.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

### **Experience You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in digital, visual, web or product design within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience working with shared libraries, design systems and workflow-enhancing plugins.
* Strong understanding of UX principles, responsive web design and accessibility.
* Demonstrated ability to organize complex information through thoughtful hierarchy, layout and visual storytelling.
* Experience creating charts, diagrams, infographics and other visual representations of technical information.
* Exceptional command of typography, composition, color, spacing and image selection.
* Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to self-QA.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage rapid turnarounds and maintain quality when priorities shift.
* Experience collaborating across regions, time zones and shift-based teams.
* Ability to work an assigned nontraditional shift and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required, as all briefs, feedback and creative deliverables will be in English.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.

### **Working Model**

This is a hybrid, shift-based role supporting a global production model. Working hours will vary by assigned shift and may include early mornings, evenings, overnight coverage or other nontraditional schedules. Participation in a planned weekend and holiday rotation will also be required. Schedules will be established in advance, with some flexibility needed around urgent priorities and cross-regional handoffs.

title: Lead Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Job Summary**
---------------

*Role Purpose*

Candescent is seeking a highly skilled Lead Designer to join our Brand & Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client-facing, executive, event, digital, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, visual problem-solving, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests.

This is a hands-on design role, not a review-only or coordination role. The Senior Designer will personally create, refine, and finalize high-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, events, and executive stakeholders. Success requires excellent judgment, strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**
-----------------------------------------

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

### **Brand Design & Visual Execution**

* Create polished visual solutions across digital, print, presentation, event, environmental, sales enablement, and internal communications projects.
* Design a wide range of assets including executive presentations, sales and marketing decks, one-pagers, ebooks, infographics, newsletters, social graphics, event materials, signage, and internal communications visuals.
* Translate complex, content-heavy, or abstract information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling communications.
* Elevate layouts, typography, hierarchy, imagery, icons, charts, and data visualizations so materials are easy to understand and unmistakably on brand.

### **Brand Consistency & Design Systems**

* Apply and extend Candescent brand standards across all assigned work, including typography, color, layout, iconography, imagery, presentation systems, and data visualization.
* Help maintain a consistent visual experience across internal and external channels, ensuring work feels connected, professional, and aligned to the company’s brand narrative.
* Use established templates and systems appropriately, while identifying opportunities to improve usability, scalability, and consistency.
* Spot and correct brand drift, formatting inconsistencies, visual clutter, and production issues before materials are delivered.

### **Production, Quality Control & Delivery**

* Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital, print, presentation, large-format, and event applications.
* Proof work carefully for alignment, spacing, hierarchy, accuracy, pagination, export settings, image quality, and brand compliance.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines at once while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.
* Respond quickly to feedback, incorporate revisions thoughtfully, and deliver final assets that require minimal rework.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Brand & Communications team members and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand audiences, and translate business needs into effective visual communications.
* Collaborate with US-based stakeholders and global team members through clear communication, organized handoffs, and reliable follow-through.
* Work with agencies, vendors, freelancers, or production partners when needed, providing files, feedback, specifications, and guidance that support high-quality outcomes.
* Operate with ownership and accountability, knowing when to ask questions, when to recommend a stronger solution, and when to move quickly to execution.

**Experience**
--------------

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 10+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within an in-house creative team, agency, corporate brand team, B2B, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise environment.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design execution across presentations, print, digital, sales enablement, events, internal communications, and brand storytelling materials.
* Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Advanced PowerPoint design skills, including executive-level presentations, slide systems, master templates, visual hierarchy, charts, diagrams, and content-heavy storytelling.
* Strong typography, layout, composition, information design, and visual storytelling skills.
* Deep understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently across multiple channels, audiences, and formats.
* Strong production knowledge, including file preparation, print production, vendor coordination, export specifications, and large-format applications.
* Experience turning complex or technical subject matter into clear, polished, visually engaging communications.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver high-quality work on deadline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly and professionally.

**Qualifications & Preferred Distinctions**
-------------------------------------------

*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Fine Arts, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience designing for executive, client, consultant, partner, or sales audiences is preferred.
* Experience with Figma, Canva, After Effects, motion graphics, web design, or digital campaign tools is a plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Brand and communications materials are polished, consistent, accurate, and recognizably Candescent across every touchpoint.
* Executive, client-facing, sales, and internal materials are visually clear, easy to follow, and delivered with a high level of craft.
* The Brand & Communications team can rely on this role for dependable, hands-on execution with minimal rework.
* Templates, systems, and recurring materials become easier to use, more consistent, and faster to produce over time.
* Stakeholders receive thoughtful design partnership, clear communication, and high-quality deliverables on deadline.
* The candidate demonstrates ownership, flexibility, and sound judgment while supporting a lean, fast-moving global team.

**What Will Make You Successful**
---------------------------------

* Outstanding typography, layout, and information design skills.
* Strong visual judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to design craftsmanship.
* Ability to create polished, production-ready work with minimal direction.
* Comfort moving quickly between projects while maintaining a consistently high quality bar.
* A practical understanding of how design supports brand perception, business goals, sales effectiveness, employee engagement, and client confidence.
* A collaborative, low-ego working style with the confidence to recommend stronger design solutions when needed.
* Strong organization, follow-through, and accountability in a global, fast-paced environment.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.
